parameters.prompt: The exact upright bear warrior in the reference performs ONE rage-activation roar in place. From the resting pose it hunches the shoulders, raises both clawed arms to the sides, then rears up and roars with the muzzle open, the chest swelling, and holds the roar. Keep the same side-view left-facing pose, bear head, fur, armor and kilt. It stays at the same spot and size and does not move across the frame. Exactly two arms and two legs. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character stays inside the frame with clear margins at all times. No jump, walking, turning, extra limbs, weapon, glow, aura, energy, red colour change, dust, rocks, cracks, particles, shadow or text. Motion beats: hunch and raise over the first second, the roar opens around one and a half seconds and is held to three seconds, then recover and hold the original pose.
